articles.title: Knicks Pull Off the Biggest Comeback in NBA Finals History!
articles.summary: Down 29 points, the New York Knicks roared back to beat the Spurs 107-106 in Game 4. OG Anunoby tipped in the winning shot with 1.2 seconds left. Now the Knicks are one win from their first title since 1973.

articles.title: UFC's Biggest Fight of the Year Is Happening at the White House!
articles.summary: Ilia Topuria and Justin Gaethje will battle for the UFC lightweight title on the White House lawn on June 14. It's part of the Freedom 250 celebration and President Trump's 80th birthday. Topuria hasn't fought in almost a year.

articles.title: A Super El Niño Is Here — and It Could Make 2027 the Hottest Year Ever
articles.summary: Scientists say El Niño has officially started in the Pacific Ocean. Sea temperatures are rising fast, and it could become a 'super' El Niño. That might bring extreme weather and make 2027 the hottest year on record.
